_comment: The only hand-written row source for the transfer ledger: one row per atom that has moved, is moving, or has been erased. Every other atom in the census is `not-moved` by default. `scripts/ops-census.mjs` writes the complete ledger to docs/ledger/transfers.json; a guard fails if a row here names an atom the census does not have, or repeats one. The office is NOT written here — it comes from lib/ops/migration-map.ts, so a move can never disagree with the map.
